pk.context: 100 mg topical, steady state, healthy adults

clues.kinetics: Only about 5% of a vaginal dose is absorbed systemically. There is little or no systemic accumulation after repeated dosing.
clues.substance: A water-soluble phosphate ester with a molecular weight of 504.96, inactive on its own until rapid hydrolysis in the body converts it to the active form.
clues.product: Approved under an NDA as a 2% cream, one 5 gram applicatorful containing about 100 mg, given once a day.
clues.safety: No boxed warning. Contraindicated after hypersensitivity to any component or with a history of regional enteritis, ulcerative colitis or antibiotic-associated colitis; skin rashes are the most frequent reaction.
clues.indication: Bacterial vaginosis in non-pregnant women, and in pregnant women during the second and third trimester.
clues.mechanism: It inhibits bacterial protein synthesis by binding the 23S RNA of the 50S ribosomal subunit, and is predominantly bacteriostatic.
